dispositions.reason: Restored the active deflection contrast: some fall, others knock the shots aside, and only the fallen stay down.
Unfolding 펼쳐 deploys the encirclement; they close in, so Form up replaces the dispersal reading.
척 is feigned composure; narration now shows pretended calm, not genuine effort.
Kept the chili euphemism and stand/pepper punchline instead of a more direct sexual gloss.
목덜미 is the scruff; 공포에 질린 modifies Hyuk, not his throat.
Removed the added deus-ex-machina framing; he appears like a savior only.
Unpacked 따위 as contempt for the likes of Taekyung, not a plain challenge.
혀가 짧구나 is a jab at a mouthy junior; rendered as bratty impertinence, not a literal tongue.
